run_plotting_cli: run the plotting CLI to generate fight and convergence plots from an experiment CSV file
create_plots_from_dataframe: create fight plots and convergence curves from a pandas DataFrame of experiment results
build_fight_plotter: build a fight plot heatmap comparing optimizer win rates across benchmark categories
build_xp_plotter: build a convergence curve plot showing loss versus budget for each optimizer
merge_optimizer_names: merge optimizer names with parametrization or other descriptors using a format pattern
